title: Voice Service State Change Indication
description: Same shape as radio.request_voice_service_state.rsp -- mirrors IPhoneListener::onVoiceServiceStateChanged(int, VoiceServiceInfo). Added for Events.json parity (tel_phone.voiceServiceStateUpdate); triggered by force_voice_service_state since there is no AP RPC that changes voice registration state.

denialCause.description: telux::tel::VoiceServiceDenialCause raw value; -1 (UNDEFINED) when not applicable.
